$comment: The knowledge base (lib/rag.js) as declared data: how a collection's knowledge may grow (its mode), and the defaults a collection starts with. A store sets a collection's mode and settings in Store console -> Knowledge. Collections are any app's: astrology, consultancy, legal, product help...

MODES.label: Expert
MODES.description: Only entries written or approved by the collection's experts are used. The AI does not draft and feedback does not change the knowledge.

MODES.label: AI-assisted
MODES.description: The AI drafts entries; each one waits for an expert's approval before it is used.

MODES.label: Self-learning
MODES.description: As AI-assisted, and ratings and corrections on answers become proposed improvements that wait for an expert's review.

MODES.label: Auto-evolving
MODES.description: Proposed improvements go live on their own once they pass the collection's thresholds (confidence, rating, confirmations). Every change is versioned and can be rolled back.

STATUSES.$comment: An entry's life: what each status means is what the engine reads.
